added_claim_errors: “14号已于2026年8月15日到期失效” states a definite conclusion where the key records inferred expiry without explicit official confirmation.
“2192元/月（应发）” and “可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额” present the disputed gross-pay interpretation without disclosing the majority interpretation that the minimum excludes personal contributions.
“在1年内申请劳动仲裁” misleadingly suggests a general one-year deadline; the key exempts wage arrears claims during employment and specifies one year after departure.
“基数要先按正常工资的70%计算” incorrectly imposes a universal 70% reduction; the resulting 4480元 entitlement and 3680元 shortfall use the wrong premise, although their arithmetic is correct.

“公司是按最低线在发，能主张的差额会少很多” treats gross pay of about 2192元 as establishing compliance despite the unresolved deduction issue and the majority interpretation requiring the minimum after personal contributions.

reasons: Both answers reject the employer’s premise and correctly calculate the 2192元 floor and 1392元 shortfall. A wins because B introduces an unsupported mandatory 70% base reduction, materially miscalculating the adopted old-tier entitlement. A nevertheless omits the concrete conditional 6400元 calculation, and both mishandle the disputed treatment of personal deductions. Both HR drafts omit requested details and statutory article references; A additionally gives misleading arbitration timing.
